descriptions.notStarted: It looks like there are a couple of people who know how to handle Wolf Pups. You should head over to #b#m211000000##k and talk to #b#p2020007##k.
descriptions.inProgress: #p2020007# has taught you the basics of mounting a wolf! With this, you'll be able to move around faster since you can ride on the wolf's back. Plus you gain valuable bonding time with your wolf. You'll have to gather materials for a saddle, since you won't be able to ride your wolf without one.\r\n\r\n#i4000048# #t4000048# #b#c4000048# / 50#k
descriptions.completed: You received the #t1912011# and Mount Skill from #p2020007#. You'll be able to roam through the entire world with this.
